item.description:
First development distribution of lucent: native mouse/key repetition up to the current 250-CPS configuration ceiling, configurable F3 Start and Command-L Open/Close defaults, glass and custom backgrounds, and manually initiated signed Sparkle updates.

This build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. macOS may require approval to open it and grant input access. General distribution still needs the documented background-storage portability change.
